decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm's owned fibre infrastructure and fits its high-bandwidth strategic direction, and it was promoted to the home page in 2019, so the option still shows growing value at low incremental carrying cost.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost software add-on that supports the existing voice business and stayed on the website through 2019, so keeping it costs little even though its prominence and upside remain modest as legacy voice services are being pruned.
